method.native: Probe-only C++ build observes actual Voice raw source, detune control, effective frequency and full PCM. Production builds contain no probe state or stores.
method.browser: Capture uncorrected carrier, actual control graph and corrected carrier in the same OfflineAudioContext.
method.independentOracle: Integrate phase from observed controls using float parameter quantization. Compare canonical note-on timing with a predeclared first-quantum prefix model; retain raw first-quantum vectors for the original case.
method.matrix: 44.1/48/96 kHz; zero, aligned and offsets 1/32/57/96/127; quarter/half/three-quarter sample positions; independent depth and LFO-rate sweeps. Exact cases and environment in report.
method.limits: This is offline evidence for the stated profile, not device/callback latency or every browser engine.

finding.controls: Native and browser detune traces agree within 0.002 cents; control math, smoothing and units are not the cause.
finding.carrier: For nonaligned starts the uncorrected browser oscillator follows the parameter-span prefix, while native follows the canonical note-relative integral. The pattern appears across sample rates; the full-voice threshold was crossed in the original 44.1kHz case.
finding.rounding: Some represented integer onsets multiply just above the nominal sample frame. An a-rate start can emit its first phase sample one frame late; the scheduling model accounts for this separately.
finding.nativeFractionalCorrection: v2 now includes the sub-sample initial phase interval in carrier and LFO state; v1 behavior remains unchanged.

correction.behavior: Start only pitch-controlled v2 carriers on a preceding render boundary. Rotate Fourier coefficients by the negative silent pre-roll phase, using the original recipe normalization. Mute the carrier gain until note-on, so filter state remains at rest. Control graphs keep authored timing. The native core stays quantum-independent.
correction.compatibility: Patch/project/execution versions v1/v2 are unchanged; legacy browser voices are not moved. No samples are baked, no fixture is removed and no PCM gate is widened.
correction.resourceScope: FFT/normalization work and bounded phase caches are control-thread preparation. Interactive preparation and hardware qualification remain open.

status: Offline native v2 profile passes unchanged PCM gates and the independent onset matrix; hardware and complete patch support remain pending
